The AI Custom Wash+ feature, which automatically sets the course based on the amount of dishes and soiling level, is incredibly convenient. I used to worry about having to scrub hard for pre-washing due to grease stains on grilled pans or burnt-on rice in bowls, but thanks to the steam soaking function and the 4-stage 3D water jets, dishes come out spotlessly clean without any extra scrubbing. 3. 100° Hot Air Drying + Automatic Door Opening. When buying a dishwasher, the most important factor for me was 'drying,' and since this product features 100° hot air drying and an automatic door opening after the wash, the level of freshness is truly different. Aside from water pooling in the backs of concave dishes, even glass cups and plastic tableware dry completely without any water stains, allowing them to be put away in the cupboard immediately. 4. Low Noise & SmartThings Integration. Even if I run it late at night in the Night Low Noise mode while I sleep, there is almost no noise or vibration, so I don't have to worry about it. Being able to check the wash completion time and progress immediately via SmartThings app notifications is also incredibly useful. For those considering a dishwasher, I highly recommend the combination of the 14-place setting large capacity and hot air drying!

Sentence (English): Let me start by saying, securing this dishwasher was a freaking nightmare.
Comments (English): Let me start by saying, securing this dishwasher was a freaking nightmare. The brackets and screws they provided were not long enough. We replaced a 15 year old GE dishwasher. The size is virtually the same, so I don't know why this was such a problem. The instructions were pretty terrible, too. Running my first cycle, I used the heated dry mode and kept checking under the sink to make sure there were no leaks. By the end of the cycle, there was condensation everywhere under my sink. It was so warm in there. That is really concerning to me because of potential mold growth if that keeps happening. I should be able to use that cycle but I don't feel like i can. I'm also disappointed that the "sections" between the tines are smaller/skinnier than my old one, so things don't fit like they did in my old one. It is very quiet. I love that. If i could actually use a boosted dry mode,I would give it 4 stars. But I have to deal with wet dishes, so that is frustrating. Really really disappointed in GE as far as installation. Also, you can see the insulation at the bottom of the unit. The cover doesn't cover it all. Why would GE think this is okay?

Sentence (English): The appliance I was looking forward to the most when moving into my new apartment was the dishwasher, and after using it myself, I immediately understood why so many people call it an essential appliance.
Comments (English): [ Wow! The plate is sparkling! ] || ---------------- || The appliance I was looking forward to the most when moving into my new apartment was the dishwasher, and after using it myself, I immediately understood why so many people call it an essential appliance. I requested scheduled delivery to coincide with my moving date, and the technician arrived exactly on time, leaving a very positive first impression. They installed it meticulously and kindly explained how to use it, making it easy to operate. My heart was pounding with excitement the entire time of installation, thinking I would finally be free from the chore of washing dishes. I urgently ordered dishwasher detergent in the morning, and fortunately, it arrived the very next evening, so I was able to use it immediately on the day of installation. I still remember how thrilled I was the moment I pressed the first wash button. The results were truly beyond my expectations. I spontaneously exclaimed, "Wow, it's a whole new world!" It cleaned much more thoroughly than washing by hand, and the cups and dishes were sparkling clean without any water stains, making me find myself opening the door again and again just to check. I was especially satisfied that even greasy frying pans and pots were cleaned spotlessly. Above all, I used to feel like washing dishes was a waste of time, but now I just put the dishes in and press a button—that’s it. The biggest advantage is that I can use that time to do other housework or relax. I think to myself several times a day, "I should have bought this sooner!" I can confidently say that this is one of the best choices I made when moving into my apartment. The design is luxurious, and the Nature Beige color blends naturally with the kitchen, making the interior look even more beautiful. The noise level is quieter than I expected, so I don't have to worry about whether it's in use, and it makes me feel good to see the dishes come out squeaky clean after washing. Now, washing dishes is no longer a stressful task, but something that is finished with a single button press. I feel no burden after every meal, and it seems like I'm spending more time with my family. I think I will continue to use it with satisfaction every day, and if you are considering buying a dishwasher, I would confidently recommend this one. Just like me, you will say, "It's a whole new world!" from the very first day of use.

'와~ 완전 신세계!'라는 말이 절로 나왔습니다. 손으로 설거지할 때보다 훨씬 깔끔하게 세척되고, 컵이나 그릇도 물자국 없이 반짝반짝해서 괜히 문을 열어보고 또 열어보게 되더라고요. 특히 기름기 있는 프라이팬이나 냄비도 깨끗하게 세척돼서 너무 만족스러웠습니다.무엇보다 설거지하는 시간이 아까웠는데 이제는 식기만 넣고 버튼 하나 누르면 끝이라 그 시간에 다른 집안일을 하거나 쉬면서 여유를 가질 수 있다는 점이 가장 큰 장점인 것 같아요. 하루에도 몇 번씩 '진작 살 걸!'이라는 생각을 합니다.  아파트 입주하면서 가장 잘한 선택 중 하나라고 자신 있게 말할 수 있습니다.디자인도 고급스럽고 네이처 베이지 색상이 주방과 자연스럽게 잘 어울려 인테리어까지 한층 더 예뻐졌어요. 소음도 생각보다 조용해서 사용 중인지 신경 쓰이지 않았고, 세척 후에는 그릇이 뽀득뽀득 깨끗하게 나와 기분까지 좋아집니다.이제는 설거지가 스트레스가 아니라 버튼 한 번으로 끝나는 일이 되었네요. 매 끼니 먹고 나서도 부담이 없고, 가족들과 보내는 시간도 더 늘어난 것 같습니다. 앞으로도 매일매일 만족하며 사용할 것 같고, 식기세척기 고민하시는 분들이 계시다면 정말 자신 있게 추천드리고 싶습니다. 저처럼 사용 첫날부터 '신세계다!'라는 말을 하시게 될 거예요.

'와~ 완전 신세계!'라는 말이 절로 나왔습니다. 손으로 설거지할 때보다 훨씬 깔끔하게 세척되고, 컵이나 그릇도 물자국 없이 반짝반짝해서 괜히 문을 열어보고 또 열어보게 되더라고요. 특히 기름기 있는 프라이팬이나 냄비도 깨끗하게 세척돼서 너무 만족스러웠습니다.무엇보다 설거지하는 시간이 아까웠는데 이제는 식기만 넣고 버튼 하나 누르면 끝이라 그 시간에 다른 집안일을 하거나 쉬면서 여유를 가질 수 있다는 점이 가장 큰 장점인 것 같아요. 하루에도 몇 번씩 '진작 살 걸!'이라는 생각을 합니다.  아파트 입주하면서 가장 잘한 선택 중 하나라고 자신 있게 말할 수 있습니다.디자인도 고급스럽고 네이처 베이지 색상이 주방과 자연스럽게 잘 어울려 인테리어까지 한층 더 예뻐졌어요. 소음도 생각보다 조용해서 사용 중인지 신경 쓰이지 않았고, 세척 후에는 그릇이 뽀득뽀득 깨끗하게 나와 기분까지 좋아집니다.이제는 설거지가 스트레스가 아니라 버튼 한 번으로 끝나는 일이 되었네요. 매 끼니 먹고 나서도 부담이 없고, 가족들과 보내는 시간도 더 늘어난 것 같습니다. 앞으로도 매일매일 만족하며 사용할 것 같고, 식기세척기 고민하시는 분들이 계시다면 정말 자신 있게 추천드리고 싶습니다. 저처럼 사용 첫날부터 '신세계다!'라는 말을 하시게 될 거예요.

Sentence (English): BOTTOM RACK HAS HORRIBLE DESIGN FLAW!
Comments (English): BOTTOM RACK HAS HORRIBLE DESIGN FLAW! Purchased this dishwasher and had it installed by Home Depot about a month ago. We were very excited to get it and have a functioning dishwasher again. However, we quickly decided we absolutely hated it because of the lower rack design flaw that impedes proper function. It is constantly coming off the "track". If there's more weight on one side of the rack, it makes it very difficult to slide the bottom rank in and out. Sentence (English): First off - if you're not using powdered detergent in the prewash spot and running tap water until it's hot before turning the dishwasher on, you're doing yourself a disservice - it makes a colossal difference.
Comments (English): [ Love it, but consider the rack layout carefully! ] || ---------------- || First off - if you're not using powdered detergent in the prewash spot and running tap water until it's hot before turning the dishwasher on, you're doing yourself a disservice - it makes a colossal difference. Hot water with detergent knocks out most of the stuff from your dishes in the initial brief wash before it drains away the first time. Having it only get hot and soapy in the second wash means you're keeping all the soiled stuff in the dishwasher for the remainder of the wash process. (Use cheap generic powder, the fancier more expensive brands perform worse to make their pods look better by comparison). Use powder or a pod, whatever, inside the closed section.)Having the large top rack rather than the small flat one other dishwashers have is a love/hate for us. It doesn't have room for coffee mugs on the small cup side and many of our glasses don't fit on the side intended for those. The upper silverware tray isn't very useful. But the glasses that comforter get cleaned really well.Likewise, having the center rack farther down reduces available height both for it and the bottom rack, but we can fit most of the things we'd want in a normal top rack into it.It does a really excellent job drying even plastics, but the bottom rack is dangerously hot and has warped/melted several of our plastic items. Softer ones survive, but inflexible hard ones are ruined. Plastic straws and cups were primary victims. I wish it had some smart features to notify when it's completed or needs to be cleaned, like our Samsung washer/dryer, but having the time expected literally showing as you select options is a very handy offset on that front , as is the unmistakable automatic opening of the dishwasher with the completed light lit. I don't really care about noise on it, but it is slightly quieter than our previous already very quiet dishwasher. Filtration - I haven't run into any issues here. We don't usually put things in that are large or solid enough to require manual cleaning of the filters, and we've only had it a couple months. Also take note that it was slightly larger than our last dishwasher and I had to perform some minor floor surgery to get it installed. I don't think people in modern homes will have the same problem, though. All in all, pretty happy with it!

Sentence (English): >>Summary. -
Comments (English): [ As expected, if the LG drying function is important, think again! ] || ---------------- || >>Summary. - Purchased at a good value thanks to the Samsung Festival discount. - The adjustable height of the middle basket was convenient. - Drying performance was less impressive than expected. - You might notice a difference if you have experience using an LG dishwasher. >>Reason for Purchase. During my recent move, I disposed of my old dishwasher and purchased a new one. My previous model was an LG dishwasher that I had used for about three years, but since it was during the Samsung Festival, the price was reasonable, so I chose a Samsung product. Actually, I initially considered more expensive models. I did a lot of comparisons, but when I thought about the features I actually needed, I realized I didn't necessarily need to go up to a model in the 1.3 million won range. So, I decided to purchase this model, which I thought offered good value for money. >>User Review. Since this is my second dishwasher, I do have some points of comparison. That is why I wanted to leave a more honest review. First off, the design is clean. It is white, but since it has a matte finish rather than a glossy one, it might look a bit plain at first. However, since my kitchen is also white-toned, it actually blended in well without looking out of place once installed. The feature I was most satisfied with was the height adjustment for the middle basket. When I used my previous dishwasher, cups or dishes placed in the middle compartment often got caught on the top basket. But with this product, the height can be easily adjusted, making it much more convenient when loading large cups or tall dishes. This feature is more useful than I expected, so I am truly satisfied. I also liked the price, as I purchased it at a pretty good deal thanks to the Samsung Festival. However, there were more drawbacks than I anticipated. The biggest disappointment was the drying performance. Since it is a hot air drying model, I had high expectations, but it was not as satisfactory as I thought. The drying vent is located on the bottom right, but the airflow feels weak, so I almost always select the "strong drying" setting. Also, if I place large items like cutting boards in front of the vent, it feels like drying doesn't work as well, so I have to be careful with the placement. Most importantly, it seems like there is always some moisture remaining near the vent, so I still haven't gotten used to this. I am considering whether I need to change the settings. Another drawback is that the remaining time is not displayed. Of course, some people might not mind it much, but since I tend to check how many minutes are left, it felt a bit frustrating. The door is also lighter than expected. It’s nice that the auto-door function opens automatically, but I was a little surprised at first because if you pull it down just a little further, it feels like it drops suddenly. Personally, I felt it could have felt a bit heavier. The controls were also less intuitive than LG's. Since you have to navigate through menus one by one using arrow buttons, it took some time to get used to it at first. I think the LG product was more intuitive. Also, the noise level was higher than expected. The Bixby voice guidance was louder than anticipated, and the sounds during rinsing and draining felt louder than the LG I used previously. This might be due to the installation environment, but personally, I found it a bit disappointing. In conclusion, I was satisfied with the price, but the drying performance—the most important factor—was less than I expected. Those buying a dishwasher for the first time might be highly satisfied, but those who, like me, have experience using an LG dishwasher might notice the difference. If I had to choose again, I think I would buy a higher-end model even if it costs a little more. I also liked the price, as I purchased it at a pretty good deal thanks to the Samsung Festival. However, there were more drawbacks than I anticipated. The biggest disappointment was the drying performance. Since it is a hot air drying model, I had high expectations, but it was not as satisfactory as I thought. The drying vent is located on the bottom right, but the airflow feels weak, so I almost always select the "strong drying" setting. Also, if I place large items like cutting boards in front of the vent, it feels like drying doesn't work as well, so I have to be careful with the placement. Most importantly, it seems like there is always some moisture remaining near the vent, so I still haven't gotten used to this. I am considering whether I need to change the settings. Another drawback is that the remaining time is not displayed. Of course, some people might not mind it much, but since I tend to check how many minutes are left, it felt a bit frustrating. Since you have to navigate through menus one by one using arrow buttons, it took some time to get used to it at first. I think the LG product was more intuitive. Also, the noise level was higher than expected. The Bixby voice guidance was louder than anticipated, and the sounds during rinsing and draining felt louder than the LG I used previously. This might be due to the installation environment, but personally, I found it a bit disappointing. In conclusion, I was satisfied with the price, but the drying performance—the most important factor—was less than I expected. Those buying a dishwasher for the first time might be highly satisfied, but those who, like me, have experience using an LG dishwasher might notice the difference. If I had to choose again, I think I would buy a higher-end model even if it costs a little more. My previous model was an LG dishwasher that I had used for about three years, but since it was during the Samsung Festival, the price was reasonable, so I chose a Samsung product. Actually, I initially considered more expensive models. I did a lot of comparisons, but when I thought about the features I actually needed, I realized I didn't necessarily need to go up to a model in the 1.3 million won range. So, I decided to purchase this model, which I thought offered good value for money. >>User Review. Since this is my second dishwasher, I do have some points of comparison. That is why I wanted to leave a more honest review. First off, the design is clean. It is white, but since it has a matte finish rather than a glossy one, it might look a bit plain at first. However, since my kitchen is also white-toned, it actually blended in well without looking out of place once installed. The feature I was most satisfied with was the height adjustment for the middle basket. When I used my previous dishwasher, cups or dishes placed in the middle compartment often got caught on the top basket. But with this product, the height can be easily adjusted, making it much more convenient when loading large cups or tall dishes. This feature is more useful than I expected, so I am truly satisfied. I also liked the price, as I purchased it at a pretty good deal thanks to the Samsung Festival. However, there were more drawbacks than I anticipated. The biggest disappointment was the drying performance. Since it is a hot air drying model, I had high expectations, but it was not as satisfactory as I thought. The drying vent is located on the bottom right, but the airflow feels weak, so I almost always select the "strong drying" setting. Also, if I place large items like cutting boards in front of the vent, it feels like drying doesn't work as well, so I have to be careful with the placement. Most importantly, it seems like there is always some moisture remaining near the vent, so I still haven't gotten used to this. I am considering whether I need to change the settings. Another drawback is that the remaining time is not displayed. Of course, some people might not mind it much, but since I tend to check how many minutes are left, it felt a bit frustrating. The door is also lighter than expected. It’s nice that the auto-door function opens automatically, but I was a little surprised at first because if you pull it down just a little further, it feels like it drops suddenly. Personally, I felt it could have felt a bit heavier. The controls were also less intuitive than LG's. Since you have to navigate through menus one by one using arrow buttons, it took some time to get used to it at first. I think the LG product was more intuitive. Also, the noise level was higher than expected. The Bixby voice guidance was louder than anticipated, and the sounds during rinsing and draining felt louder than the LG I used previously. This might be due to the installation environment, but personally, I found it a bit disappointing. In conclusion, I was satisfied with the price, but the drying performance—the most important factor—was less than I expected. Those buying a dishwasher for the first time might be highly satisfied, but those who, like me, have experience using an LG dishwasher might notice the difference. If I had to choose again, I think I would buy a higher-end model even if it costs a little more. I highly recommend comparing models before purchasing, especially for those who prioritize the drying function! >> Good. - Purchased at a good price thanks to the Samsung Festival discount. - Middle basket height is adjustable. - Design matches a white kitchen well. - Ample storage space as it is a 14-place setting. >> Disappointing. - Drying performance was less impressive than expected. - Remaining time is not displayed. - The door opens too easily. - Button operation is not intuitive. - The noise from the drainage and voice guidance is on the louder side. During my recent move, I disposed of my old dishwasher and purchased a new one. My previous model was an LG dishwasher that I had used for about three years, but since it was during the Samsung Festival, the price was reasonable, so I chose a Samsung product. Actually, I initially considered more expensive models. I did a lot of comparisons, but when I thought about the features I actually needed, I realized I didn't necessarily need to go up to a model in the 1.3 million won range. So, I decided to purchase this model, which I thought offered good value for money. >>User Review. Since this is my second dishwasher, I do have some points of comparison. That is why I wanted to leave a more honest review. First off, the design is clean. It is white, but since it has a matte finish rather than a glossy one, it might look a bit plain at first. However, since my kitchen is also white-toned, it actually blended in well without looking out of place once installed. The feature I was most satisfied with was the height adjustment for the middle basket. When I used my previous dishwasher, cups or dishes placed in the middle compartment often got caught on the top basket. But with this product, the height can be easily adjusted, making it much more convenient when loading large cups or tall dishes. This feature is more useful than I expected, so I am truly satisfied. I also liked the price, as I purchased it at a pretty good deal thanks to the Samsung Festival. However, there were more drawbacks than I anticipated. The biggest disappointment was the drying performance. Since it is a hot air drying model, I had high expectations, but it was not as satisfactory as I thought. The drying vent is located on the bottom right, but the airflow feels weak, so I almost always select the "strong drying" setting. Also, if I place large items like cutting boards in front of the vent, it feels like drying doesn't work as well, so I have to be careful with the placement. Most importantly, it seems like there is always some moisture remaining near the vent, so I still haven't gotten used to this. I am considering whether I need to change the settings. Another drawback is that the remaining time is not displayed. Of course, some people might not mind it much, but since I tend to check how many minutes are left, it felt a bit frustrating. The door is also lighter than expected. It’s nice that the auto-door function opens automatically, but I was a little surprised at first because if you pull it down just a little further, it feels like it drops suddenly. Personally, I felt it could have felt a bit heavier. The controls were also less intuitive than LG's. Since you have to navigate through menus one by one using arrow buttons, it took some time to get used to it at first. I think the LG product was more intuitive. Also, the noise level was higher than expected. The Bixby voice guidance was louder than anticipated, and the sounds during rinsing and draining felt louder than the LG I used previously. This might be due to the installation environment, but personally, I found it a bit disappointing. In conclusion, I was satisfied with the price, but the drying performance—the most important factor—was less than I expected. Those buying a dishwasher for the first time might be highly satisfied, but those who, like me, have experience using an LG dishwasher might notice the difference. If I had to choose again, I think I would buy a higher-end model even if it costs a little more. I highly recommend comparing models before purchasing, especially for those who prioritize the drying function! >> Good. - Purchased at a good price thanks to the Samsung Festival discount. - Middle basket height is adjustable. - Design matches a white kitchen well. - Ample storage space as it is a 14-place setting. >> Disappointing. - Drying performance was less impressive than expected. - Remaining time is not displayed. - The door opens too easily. - Button operation is not intuitive. - The noise from the drainage and voice guidance is on the louder side. My previous model was an LG dishwasher that I had used for about three years, but since it was during the Samsung Festival, the price was reasonable, so I chose a Samsung product. Actually, I initially considered more expensive models. I did a lot of comparisons, but when I thought about the features I actually needed, I realized I didn't necessarily need to go up to a model in the 1.3 million won range. So, I decided to purchase this model, which I thought offered good value for money. >>User Review. Since this is my second dishwasher, I do have some points of comparison. That is why I wanted to leave a more honest review. First off, the design is clean. It is white, but since it has a matte finish rather than a glossy one, it might look a bit plain at first. However, since my kitchen is also white-toned, it actually blended in well without looking out of place once installed. The feature I was most satisfied with was the height adjustment for the middle basket. When I used my previous dishwasher, cups or dishes placed in the middle compartment often got caught on the top basket. But with this product, the height can be easily adjusted, making it much more convenient when loading large cups or tall dishes. This feature is more useful than I expected, so I am truly satisfied. I also liked the price, as I purchased it at a pretty good deal thanks to the Samsung Festival. However, there were more drawbacks than I anticipated. The biggest disappointment was the drying performance. Since it is a hot air drying model, I had high expectations, but it was not as satisfactory as I thought. The drying vent is located on the bottom right, but the airflow feels weak, so I almost always select the "strong drying" setting. Also, if I place large items like cutting boards in front of the vent, it feels like drying doesn't work as well, so I have to be careful with the placement. Most importantly, it seems like there is always some moisture remaining near the vent, so I still haven't gotten used to this. I am considering whether I need to change the settings. Another drawback is that the remaining time is not displayed. Of course, some people might not mind it much, but since I tend to check how many minutes are left, it felt a bit frustrating. The door is also lighter than expected. It’s nice that the auto-door function opens automatically, but I was a little surprised at first because if you pull it down just a little further, it feels like it drops suddenly. Personally, I felt it could have felt a bit heavier. The controls were also less intuitive than LG's. Since you have to navigate through menus one by one using arrow buttons, it took some time to get used to it at first. I think the LG product was more intuitive. Also, the noise level was higher than expected. The Bixby voice guidance was louder than anticipated, and the sounds during rinsing and draining felt louder than the LG I used previously. This might be due to the installation environment, but personally, I found it a bit disappointing. In conclusion, I was satisfied with the price, but the drying performance—the most important factor—was less than I expected. Those buying a dishwasher for the first time might be highly satisfied, but those who, like me, have experience using an LG dishwasher might notice the difference. If I had to choose again, I think I would buy a higher-end model even if it costs a little more. I highly recommend comparing models before purchasing, especially for those who prioritize the drying function! >> Good. - Purchased at a good price thanks to the Samsung Festival discount. - Middle basket height is adjustable. - Design matches a white kitchen well. - Ample storage space as it is a 14-place setting. >> Disappointing. - Drying performance was less impressive than expected. - Remaining time is not displayed. - The door opens too easily. - Button operation is not intuitive. - The noise from the drainage and voice guidance is on the louder side. During my recent move, I disposed of my old dishwasher and purchased a new one. My previous model was an LG dishwasher that I had used for about three years, but since it was during the Samsung Festival, the price was reasonable, so I chose a Samsung product. Actually, I initially considered more expensive models. I did a lot of comparisons, but when I thought about the features I actually needed, I realized I didn't necessarily need to go up to a model in the 1.3 million won range. So, I decided to purchase this model, which I thought offered good value for money. >>User Review. Since this is my second dishwasher, I do have some points of comparison. That is why I wanted to leave a more honest review. First off, the design is clean. It is white, but since it has a matte finish rather than a glossy one, it might look a bit plain at first. However, since my kitchen is also white-toned, it actually blended in well without looking out of place once installed. The feature I was most satisfied with was the height adjustment for the middle basket. When I used my previous dishwasher, cups or dishes placed in the middle compartment often got caught on the top basket. But with this product, the height can be easily adjusted, making it much more convenient when loading large cups or tall dishes. This feature is more useful than I expected, so I am truly satisfied. I also liked the price, as I purchased it at a pretty good deal thanks to the Samsung Festival. However, there were more drawbacks than I anticipated. The biggest disappointment was the drying performance. Since it is a hot air drying model, I had high expectations, but it was not as satisfactory as I thought. The drying vent is located on the bottom right, but the airflow feels weak, so I almost always select the "strong drying" setting. Also, if I place large items like cutting boards in front of the vent, it feels like drying doesn't work as well, so I have to be careful with the placement. Most importantly, it seems like there is always some moisture remaining near the vent, so I still haven't gotten used to this. I am considering whether I need to change the settings. Another drawback is that the remaining time is not displayed. Of course, some people might not mind it much, but since I tend to check how many minutes are left, it felt a bit frustrating. The door is also lighter than expected. It’s nice that the auto-door function opens automatically, but I was a little surprised at first because if you pull it down just a little further, it feels like it drops suddenly. Personally, I felt it could have felt a bit heavier. The controls were also less intuitive than LG's. Since you have to navigate through menus one by one using arrow buttons, it took some time to get used to it at first. I think the LG product was more intuitive. Also, the noise level was higher than expected. The Bixby voice guidance was louder than anticipated, and the sounds during rinsing and draining felt louder than the LG I used previously. This might be due to the installation environment, but personally, I found it a bit disappointing. In conclusion, I was satisfied with the price, but the drying performance—the most important factor—was less than I expected. Those buying a dishwasher for the first time might be highly satisfied, but those who, like me, have experience using an LG dishwasher might notice the difference. If I had to choose again, I think I would buy a higher-end model even if it costs a little more. I highly recommend comparing models before purchasing, especially for those who prioritize the drying function! >> Good. - Purchased at a good price thanks to the Samsung Festival discount. - Middle basket height is adjustable. - Design matches a white kitchen well. - Ample storage space as it is a 14-place setting. >> Disappointing. - Drying performance was less impressive than expected. - Remaining time is not displayed. - The door opens too easily. - Button operation is not intuitive. - The noise from the drainage and voice guidance is on the louder side. My previous model was an LG dishwasher that I had used for about three years, but since it was during the Samsung Festival, the price was reasonable, so I chose a Samsung product. Actually, I initially considered more expensive models. I did a lot of comparisons, but when I thought about the features I actually needed, I realized I didn't necessarily need to go up to a model in the 1.3 million won range. So, I decided to purchase this model, which I thought offered good value for money. >>User Review. Since this is my second dishwasher, I do have some points of comparison. That is why I wanted to leave a more honest review. First off, the design is clean. It is white, but since it has a matte finish rather than a glossy one, it might look a bit plain at first. However, since my kitchen is also white-toned, it actually blended in well without looking out of place once installed. The feature I was most satisfied with was the height adjustment for the middle basket. When I used my previous dishwasher, cups or dishes placed in the middle compartment often got caught on the top basket. But with this product, the height can be easily adjusted, making it much more convenient when loading large cups or tall dishes. This feature is more useful than I expected, so I am truly satisfied. I also liked the price, as I purchased it at a pretty good deal thanks to the Samsung Festival. However, there were more drawbacks than I anticipated. The biggest disappointment was the drying performance. Since it is a hot air drying model, I had high expectations, but it was not as satisfactory as I thought. The drying vent is located on the bottom right, but the airflow feels weak, so I almost always select the "strong drying" setting. Also, if I place large items like cutting boards in front of the vent, it feels like drying doesn't work as well, so I have to be careful with the placement. Most importantly, it seems like there is always some moisture remaining near the vent, so I still haven't gotten used to this. I am considering whether I need to change the settings. Another drawback is that the remaining time is not displayed. Of course, some people might not mind it much, but since I tend to check how many minutes are left, it felt a bit frustrating. The door is also lighter than expected. It’s nice that the auto-door function opens automatically, but I was a little surprised at first because if you pull it down just a little further, it feels like it drops suddenly. Personally, I felt it could have felt a bit heavier. The controls were also less intuitive than LG's. Since you have to navigate through menus one by one using arrow buttons, it took some time to get used to it at first. I think the LG product was more intuitive. Also, the noise level was higher than expected. The Bixby voice guidance was louder than anticipated, and the sounds during rinsing and draining felt louder than the LG I used previously. This might be due to the installation environment, but personally, I found it a bit disappointing. In conclusion, I was satisfied with the price, but the drying performance—the most important factor—was less than I expected. Those buying a dishwasher for the first time might be highly satisfied, but those who, like me, have experience using an LG dishwasher might notice the difference. If I had to choose again, I think I would buy a higher-end model even if it costs a little more. I highly recommend comparing models before purchasing, especially for those who prioritize the drying function! >> Good. - Purchased at a good price thanks to the Samsung Festival discount. - Middle basket height is adjustable. - Design matches a white kitchen well. - Ample storage space as it is a 14-place setting. >> Disappointing. - Drying performance was less impressive than expected. - Remaining time is not displayed. - The door opens too easily. - Button operation is not intuitive. - The noise from the drainage and voice guidance is on the louder side. Comments (English): [ As expected, if the LG drying function is important, think again! ] || ---------------- || >>Summary. - Purchased at a good value thanks to the Samsung Festival discount. - The adjustable height of the middle basket was convenient. - Drying performance was less impressive than expected. - You might notice a difference if you have experience using an LG dishwasher. >>Reason for Purchase. During my recent move, I disposed of my old dishwasher and purchased a new one. My previous model was an LG dishwasher that I had used for about three years, but since it was during the Samsung Festival, the price was reasonable, so I chose a Samsung product. Actually, I initially considered more expensive models. I did a lot of comparisons, but when I thought about the features I actually needed, I realized I didn't necessarily need to go up to a model in the 1.3 million won range. So, I decided to purchase this model, which I thought offered good value for money. >>User Review. Since this is my second dishwasher, I do have some points of comparison. That is why I wanted to leave a more honest review. First off, the design is clean. It is white, but since it has a matte finish rather than a glossy one, it might look a bit plain at first. However, since my kitchen is also white-toned, it actually blended in well without looking out of place once installed. The feature I was most satisfied with was the height adjustment for the middle basket. When I used my previous dishwasher, cups or dishes placed in the middle compartment often got caught on the top basket. But with this product, the height can be easily adjusted, making it much more convenient when loading large cups or tall dishes. This feature is more useful than I expected, so I am truly satisfied. I also liked the price, as I purchased it at a pretty good deal thanks to the Samsung Festival. However, there were more drawbacks than I anticipated. The biggest disappointment was the drying performance. Since it is a hot air drying model, I had high expectations, but it was not as satisfactory as I thought. The drying vent is located on the bottom right, but the airflow feels weak, so I almost always select the "strong drying" setting. Also, if I place large items like cutting boards in front of the vent, it feels like drying doesn't work as well, so I have to be careful with the placement. Most importantly, it seems like there is always some moisture remaining near the vent, so I still haven't gotten used to this. I am considering whether I need to change the settings. Another drawback is that the remaining time is not displayed. Of course, some people might not mind it much, but since I tend to check how many minutes are left, it felt a bit frustrating. The door is also lighter than expected. It’s nice that the auto-door function opens automatically, but I was a little surprised at first because if you pull it down just a little further, it feels like it drops suddenly. Personally, I felt it could have felt a bit heavier. The controls were also less intuitive than LG's. Since you have to navigate through menus one by one using arrow buttons, it took some time to get used to it at first. I think the LG product was more intuitive. Also, the noise level was higher than expected. The Bixby voice guidance was louder than anticipated, and the sounds during rinsing and draining felt louder than the LG I used previously. This might be due to the installation environment, but personally, I found it a bit disappointing. In conclusion, I was satisfied with the price, but the drying performance—the most important factor—was less than I expected. Those buying a dishwasher for the first time might be highly satisfied, but those who, like me, have experience using an LG dishwasher might notice the difference. If I had to choose again, I think I would buy a higher-end model even if it costs a little more. I highly recommend comparing models before purchasing, especially for those who prioritize the drying function! >> Good. - Purchased at a good price thanks to the Samsung Festival discount. - Middle basket height is adjustable. - Design matches a white kitchen well. - Ample storage space as it is a 14-place setting. >> Disappointing. - Drying performance was less impressive than expected. - Remaining time is not displayed. - The door opens too easily. - Button operation is not intuitive. - The noise from the drainage and voice guidance is on the louder side. But with this product, the height can be easily adjusted, making it much more convenient when loading large cups or tall dishes. This feature is more useful than I expected, so I am truly satisfied. I also liked the price, as I purchased it at a pretty good deal thanks to the Samsung Festival. However, there were more drawbacks than I anticipated. The biggest disappointment was the drying performance. Since it is a hot air drying model, I had high expectations, but it was not as satisfactory as I thought. The drying vent is located on the bottom right, but the airflow feels weak, so I almost always select the "strong drying" setting. Also, if I place large items like cutting boards in front of the vent, it feels like drying doesn't work as well, so I have to be careful with the placement. Most importantly, it seems like there is always some moisture remaining near the vent, so I still haven't gotten used to this. I am considering whether I need to change the settings. Another drawback is that the remaining time is not displayed. Of course, some people might not mind it much, but since I tend to check how many minutes are left, it felt a bit frustrating. The door is also lighter than expected. It’s nice that the auto-door function opens automatically, but I was a little surprised at first because if you pull it down just a little further, it feels like it drops suddenly. Personally, I felt it could have felt a bit heavier. The controls were also less intuitive than LG's. Since you have to navigate through menus one by one using arrow buttons, it took some time to get used to it at first. I think the LG product was more intuitive. Also, the noise level was higher than expected. The Bixby voice guidance was louder than anticipated, and the sounds during rinsing and draining felt louder than the LG I used previously. This might be due to the installation environment, but personally, I found it a bit disappointing. In conclusion, I was satisfied with the price, but the drying performance—the most important factor—was less than I expected. Those buying a dishwasher for the first time might be highly satisfied, but those who, like me, have experience using an LG dishwasher might notice the difference. If I had to choose again, I think I would buy a higher-end model even if it costs a little more. I highly recommend comparing models before purchasing, especially for those who prioritize the drying function! >> Good. - Purchased at a good price thanks to the Samsung Festival discount. - Middle basket height is adjustable. - Design matches a white kitchen well. - Ample storage space as it is a 14-place setting. >> Disappointing. - Drying performance was less impressive than expected. - Remaining time is not displayed. - The door opens too easily. - Button operation is not intuitive. - The noise from the drainage and voice guidance is on the louder side. Sentence (English): First off - if you're not using powdered detergent in the prewash spot and running tap water until it's hot before turning the dishwasher on, you're doing yourself a disservice - it makes a colossal difference.
Comments (English): [ Love it, but consider the rack layout carefully! ] || ---------------- || First off - if you're not using powdered detergent in the prewash spot and running tap water until it's hot before turning the dishwasher on, you're doing yourself a disservice - it makes a colossal difference. Hot water with detergent knocks out most of the stuff from your dishes in the initial brief wash before it drains away the first time. Having it only get hot and soapy in the second wash means you're keeping all the soiled stuff in the dishwasher for the remainder of the wash process. (Use cheap generic powder, the fancier more expensive brands perform worse to make their pods look better by comparison). Use powder or a pod, whatever, inside the closed section.). Having the large top rack rather than the small flat one other dishwashers have is a love/hate for us. It doesn't have room for coffee mugs on the small cup side and many of our glasses don't fit on the side intended for those. The upper silverware tray isn't very useful. But the glasses that comforter get cleaned really well. Likewise, having the center rack farther down reduces available height both for it and the bottom rack, but we can fit most of the things we'd want in a normal top rack into it. It does a really excellent job drying even plastics, but the bottom rack is dangerously hot and has warped/melted several of our plastic items. Softer ones survive, but inflexible hard ones are ruined. Plastic straws and cups were primary victims. I wish it had some smart features to notify when it's completed or needs to be cleaned, like our Samsung washer/dryer, but having the time expected literally showing as you select options is a very handy offset on that front , as is the unmistakable automatic opening of the dishwasher with the completed light lit. I don't really care about noise on it, but it is slightly quieter than our previous already very quiet dishwasher. Filtration - I haven't run into any issues here. We don't usually put things in that are large or solid enough to require manual cleaning of the filters, and we've only had it a couple months. Also take note that it was slightly larger than our last dishwasher and I had to perform some minor floor surgery to get it installed. I don't think people in modern homes will have the same problem, though. All in all, pretty happy with it!

Sentence (English): I bought a dishwasher along with replacing the upper and lower cabinets.
Comments (English): I bought a dishwasher along with replacing the upper and lower cabinets. Luckily, I purchased it during the Samsung Festa, so I was happy to get the 14-place setting model for less than 1 million won. We are a family of four with two children, and I considered getting the 12-place setting, but I decided to buy the 14-place setting with the plan of running it once a day, and it fits perfectly. I would have regretted it if I had bought the 12-place setting. Hand washing dishes takes 1 to 2 hours, and my neck, shoulders, back, legs, ankles, and entire body ache. It is difficult to do the dishes while watching the kids, so I do them after they go to sleep. I thought it would be nice to use that time for other housework or to rest. When raising children, there is just so much housework to do besides dishwashing. I love that I can control it via SmartThings and that the door opens automatically. Although it doesn't use hot air, if I use the high-temperature powerful drying mode and leave the door open, it dries faster than usual, and it seems to have a sterilizing effect, which I like. I was also impressed by the plastic mode on SmartThings. I thought I would have to hand-wash plastic tableware, but this takes care of that as well. It also allows me to wash the countertops separately, so it is great in many ways. I scheduled delivery for the 14th, but they arrived on the 21st; luckily, the dates and times aligned, so the renovation and installation were completed in just one day.
Comments (Original): [ 상하부장 교체하면서 식세기도 같이 들였어요. 마침 삼성페스타때 사서 100만원도 안하는 금액으로 14인용을 사서 좋았어요. 아이 둘있는 4인가구인데 12인용할까 고민했는데 하루 한 ] || ---------------- || 상하부장 교체하면서 식세기도 같이 들였어요. 마침 삼성페스타때 사서 100만원도 안하는 금액으로 14인용을 사서 좋았어요. 아이 둘있는 4인가구인데 12인용할까 고민했는데 하루 한번 돌리자는 맘으로 14인용 샀더니 딱이에요. 12인용 샀으면 후회할뻔했어요. 손 설거지 하는 시간이 1~2시간은 걸리고 목 어깨 허리 다리 발목 전신이 아파요 ㅠㅠ 애들 보면서 설거지까지 하기 힘들어서 애들 자면 설거지하는데 그 시간에 다른 집안일하든지 쉬면 좋겠다 싶었어요. 애 키우는데 집안일은 설거지말고도 할게 너무 많잖아요. 스마트싱스로 연결해서 제어할 수도 있고 자동문열림 되는게 넘 좋아요. 열풍은 안나오지만 고온으로 강력건조모드 하고 문열어두면 평소보다 빠르게 건조되고 살균효과 되는거같아 좋아요. 스마트싱스에 플라스틱모드 있는거에 또 감동. 플라스틱 식기류는 손설거지해야겠다 싶었는데 그런거까지 다 해주고 ㅠㅠ 상판 설거지만 따로 할 수도 있고 여러모로 좋네요. 배송은 14일 지정했는데 21일에 오셨지만 운좋게 날짜 시간이 맞아서 하루만에 리폼 설치 완료했습니다.

We are a family of four with two children, and I considered getting the 12-place setting, but I decided to buy the 14-place setting with the plan of running it once a day, and it fits perfectly. I would have regretted it if I had bought the 12-place setting. Hand washing dishes takes 1 to 2 hours, and my neck, shoulders, back, legs, ankles, and entire body ache. It is difficult to do the dishes while watching the kids, so I do them after they go to sleep. I thought it would be nice to use that time for other housework or to rest. When raising children, there is just so much housework to do besides dishwashing. I love that I can control it via SmartThings and that the door opens automatically. Although it doesn't use hot air, if I use the high-temperature powerful drying mode and leave the door open, it dries faster than usual, and it seems to have a sterilizing effect, which I like. I was also impressed by the plastic mode on SmartThings. I thought I would have to hand-wash plastic tableware, but this takes care of that as well. It also allows me to wash the countertops separately, so it is great in many ways. I scheduled delivery for the 14th, but they arrived on the 21st; luckily, the dates and times aligned, so the renovation and installation were completed in just one day.

Comments (English): My old dishwasher was getting old, so I decided to replace it with a new one. First off, the design is beautiful, it's quiet, and looks sturdy. The only downside is that it doesn't dry completely. If you leave the door open after drying, it dries about 80-90%. I tried using the Samsung 6-place setting dishwasher. It definitely reduced dishwashing time, which has improved my quality of life. After a meal, I just put the dishes in and run it, and they are cleaned thoroughly, significantly reducing the time spent washing by hand. Since it's a 6-place setting, the capacity is suitable for a family of 2 to 4 people, and it was convenient to wash everything at once because I could load dishes and cups efficiently. I was satisfied that water stains and grease were cleanly removed after washing. The noise level wasn't bothersome, so I could use it comfortably even in the evening, and the clean design matched my kitchen decor well. Most of all, I am truly satisfied because I feel liberated from the chore of washing dishes that require frequent hand contact. I recommend this product to anyone who wants to reduce dishwashing time or maintain their dishes hygienically.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher worked well for about a year.
Comments (English): [ Poor Filter Design, Abysmal Customer Service, Deceptive Product Description ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher worked well for about a year. It stopped working due to an F9E1 code, which meant that it would not drain. We went through all the troubleshooting steps, but could not figure out where the filter was. There was no picture of where to find it in the owner's manual. After spending two days trying to figure it out, I discovered the issue on a YouTube video by a disgruntled customer. It turns out that one needs to dissassemble the entire bottom part of the dishwasher before one can get to the filter. How can this be since the manual clearly says to clean the filter at least once a year if one washes and rinses the dishes before putting them into the washer? One needs a technician's help just to clean the filter! When I called the troubleshooting number, I discovered that Whirlpool had bought Maytag -- and the so-called troubleshooting number didn't do troubleshooting at all. The operator was rude, and he didn't even know where the filter was, let alone how to clean it. It took a Youtube video to get me that information. I specifically chose a Maytag appliance because the brand had such a stellar reputation in years past. It seems that that reputation, along with the brand itself, has gone the way of the dinosaur. As for Home Depot's product description, it should have borne a warning that the company had changed hands. If I had known that Whirlpool had bought out the Maytag company, I would never have purchased the appliance. I have had nothing but trouble from Whirlpool appliances. For example, my last dishwashter was a Whirlpool, and it stopped working after only 3 years of light use. My Whirlpool refrigerator was even worse. The supports for the Flexi-Slide bin (the cheese drawer) broke in less than a year. Buy this dishwasher at your peril. It runs like a dream -- until it doesn't. Then, the dream turns into a nightmare.

Sentence (English): I recently downgraded to this dishwasher from a Kitchen Aid model.
Comments (English): [ Downgraded to BETTER!  ] || ---------------- || I recently downgraded to this dishwasher from a Kitchen Aid model. This one is it has completely transformed how our kitchen runs. After weeks of testing, the standout feature for me is how incredibly quiet it is. I have tested it with baked-on food and heavy grease without pre-rinsing, and everything comes out spotless and gleaming. The addition of a 3rd rack is an absolute game-changer, providing the perfect dedicated space for small items, lids, and long utensils.My only minor critique is that the standard automatic cycle takes a little over two hours to complete, which feels a bit long. However, given how beautifully clean and dry the dishes come out (especially when using rinse aid), the wait is entirely worth it. It offers excellent value for the price and I highly recommend it.

Sentence (English): I purchased a new dishwasher for my tenant during Costco's promotion.
Comments (English): [ Great Costco Deal, but Disappointing Installation ] || ---------------- || I purchased a new dishwasher for my tenant during Costco's promotion. The price was very good , a $300 discount, free installation, and free haul-away. Overall, the deal was much better than other stores.However, the installation experience was disappointing. When the technician arrived, he found two issues and said he could not install the dishwasher unless they were corrected. He offered to fix the issues for an additional $220.The first issue was that the old dishwasher was hardwired, and he said it needed to be changed to an electrical outlet to meet code. I am not an electrical expert, so I checked online afterward and found that this may not always be required, depending on the situation.The second issue was the dishwasher air gap. My old dishwasher did not have one, but after checking, I understand this may be required by newer code requirements in some areas.Before this installation, I had another local dishwasher technician inspect my old dishwasher, and they did not mention any of these issues. Therefore, I assumed the replacement would be straightforward. Since my tenant needed the dishwasher installed and I did not want to delay the service, I agreed to pay the additional $220.The Costco price was still a good value compared with other stores, but the installation experience with this technician was frustrating. I hope Costco can improve communication about possible installation requirements and additional charges before the appointment.

Sentence (English): I would love to write a review for this product.
Comments (English): [ Can I Just Have My Unit Please? ] || ---------------- || I would love to write a review for this product. I would like to say that it hums like a dream, makes my dishes squeaky clean, and has all the things I need to make a wash cycle painless. But I can't. I can't because I don't have a dishwasher that I can trust actually running without causing additional issues. Let's break it down.6/30/2026 - Put in the order, found that there was some kind of issue with the payment, got it resolved, got another message saying it wasn't resolved. Call in for them to say it was resolved and they have no record of the second message. Cool.7/9/2026 - Install date. Trying to be understanding. Unit has to be sent to a nearby store, store has to work it out with the installer, installer needs to schedule out. I'm not exactly pleased about the wait, but I get it, these things happen. Unit comes in, swap is done. Old unit out, new unit in. I have my own job to do, so other than just checking things out at times to see if I can learn anything, I leave them to it. They have some trouble with the set-up. Maybe something about the counter vexes them, I don't know, but eventually they manage. By the time I check on them again, they are wrapping up. Units closing up and draining, they say everything is good. Congratulations all around, they leave. I have a few dishes I can put in, why not give it a whirl? I open the dishwasher to a metallic flexing sound. Upon inspection, I find that they put a screw into one side of the kick plate but not the other, so the door catches on the unsecured side. Annoying, but it can be worked out.I find that something is weird about the door. It falls heavy. No resistance, just down like a ton of bricks. Is the door even connected right? Who knows? But I'm paranoid and now can't use it.7/10/2026 - Call Lowe's to tell them my woes. I get punted to LG. I call Lowe's back and tell them I have an issue with them and the installer at the moment, not LG. I tell them about the kickplate and the door. I have to wait for the installer to get back to me.7/13/2026 - Installer gets back to me, says they can send a more experienced person the next Tuesday or they have someone sooner on the Thursday, but they're a little greener. In an effort to create the least amount of back and forth, I opt for the next Tuesday. I believed this would be better for everyone involved.7/21/2026 - Installers are back out and they take a look. They see the door is definitely not right (the kick plate is automatic). They try to fix it but can't. Said they'd put in a request to replace the unit. More time, but I understand that this is better than dealing with a unit that could go sideways on us. Nobody needs water damage in their lives if they can help it. They say they'll put in the order and be back in touch for another install date.7/22/2026 - Towards the evening. Call Lowe's to see if they have the order. They do not. I tell them the situation and they tell me that if it's a manufacturer defect, then they'll have to settle up with LG. Okay, but what does that have to do with me? So either the unit I got was delivered defective or it was trashed by the installers when they made delivery. I don't know. Not my job to point fingers. I will say that there should at least be a cursory check on a unit when handed off to the installer, if only for the workers at the location to say “Everything was fine on our end.” For everyone to miss a door issue that I could feel when I held it is not exactly an endorsement. This is a lot of time, and now I'm going to have to wait for another unit after who knows how much more time will be spent between parties playing hot potato with my issue until someone gets back to me. So yeah…I'd love a working unit to actually review, but that is not in the cards for me at the moment.

Sentence (English): I am extremely disappointed with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Not compatible with most modern kitchen faucets ] || ---------------- || I am extremely disappointed with this dishwasher. The biggest issue is that it is marketed as a portable dishwasher, yet it is only compatible with a very limited range of faucets. Like most homes, my kitchen has a pull-down faucet, and there is no way to connect the included adapter. Whirlpool offers no practical solution for modern pull-down faucets. I spent hours researching adapters, comparing thread sizes, and trying to find a workaround. I purchased additional parts, searched multiple hardware stores, and still could not get the dishwasher connected to my kitchen sink. Even my basement utility sink required special adapters because the included connection only fits certain faucet threads. After all of that, I still cannot use this dishwasher where it belongs—in my kitchen. Instead, I now have to carry dirty dishes down to my basement every time I want to run it. That completely defeats the purpose of buying a portable dishwasher. The dishwasher itself may clean dishes well, but Whirlpool's outdated faucet connection design makes it incompatible with many modern homes. If you have a pull-down, pull-out, or other nonstandard faucet, assume this dishwasher will not work without a frustrating amount of trial and error. I would not have purchased this model had I known how difficult it would be to connect.

I purchased additional parts, searched multiple hardware stores, and still could not get the dishwasher connected to my kitchen sink. I even contacted Whirlpool for assistance. Instead, I now have to carry dirty dishes down to my basement every time I want to run it. That completely defeats the purpose of buying a portable dishwasher.The dishwasher itself may clean dishes well, but Whirlpool's outdated faucet connection design makes it incompatible with many modern homes. Sentence (English): I agonized endlessly over whether or not to buy a dishwasher.
Comments (English): I agonized endlessly over whether or not to buy a dishwasher. In the end, I'm glad I did. I made the right choice going with the DUE6BGL1E 14-place setting model. I worried about the installation size because it was a bit tricky, I worried about the installation cost because I didn't know it, I worried about the color, and I worried about the location—it was an endless struggle. But it looks so beautiful that the time I spent worrying feels like a waste. It is the Nature Beige color. I heard many people install it under the gas stove, but I didn't want to, so I used one and a half sections of my existing cabinet. They cut the existing cabinet themselves and fixed it right away that day. (Since it was a non-standard size, it cost me an extra 180,000 won.) They came immediately on the date and time I specified when ordering. I recommend allowing at least two hours for installation. Since using the dishwasher, my dishwashing time has decreased significantly. Especially after eating, I put the dishes in the dishwasher, walk around, and if I find other dishes, I put them in as well. It is very convenient because I just have to press a button. At first, I was worried because there were so many different types, but since the options were organized in a table, I chose one that includes both steam and hot air drying. The cleaning power is better than expected! I am extremely satisfied. I am satisfied because dishes and pots are cleaned thoroughly, and no water stains are left behind. The operating noise is not loud, so I can use it comfortably even in the evening or at night. It is also convenient because the dishes dry neatly and can be stored immediately. (Sometimes I even take the dishes out of the dishwasher to use them.) If you have a pull-down, pull-out, or other nonstandard faucet, assume this dishwasher will not work without a frustrating amount of trial and error. I would not have purchased this model had I known how difficult it would be to connect.

I will NEVER have Home Depot install anything else!

Sentence (English): Washing dishes used to be the most tedious chore of the house, so I purchased this one after my previous one broke down.
Comments (English): Washing dishes used to be the most tedious chore of the house, so I purchased this one after my previous one broke down. I was hesitant because built-in installation is difficult in my home, but since it is a countertop model, I was able to install it without any hassle, and it didn't take up as much space as I expected. The most satisfying aspect is its cleaning power. It cleans greasy plates and pots thoroughly, and cups and glassware are finished spotlessly, so I rarely wash dishes by hand anymore. Thanks to the high-temperature washing function, I can use it hygienically, giving me peace of mind when washing children's dishes or cutting boards. It feels slightly larger than the 6-person model I used before, which is nice. The dishes do not smell after use, so I was able to use it pleasantly at all times. The intuitive controls are also a plus, making it easy to select various washing courses. However, due to the nature of a countertop model, it is difficult to fit many frying pans or large pots at once, and I initially needed a knack for arranging the dishes. But once I got used to it, I was able to use it more efficiently. Sentence (English): I am extremely disappointed with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Not compatible with most modern faucets ] || ---------------- || I am extremely disappointed with this dishwasher. The biggest issue is that it is marketed as a portable dishwasher, yet it is only compatible with a very limited range of faucets. Like many newer homes, my kitchen has a pull-down faucet, and there is no way to connect the included adapter. Whirlpool offers no practical solution for modern pull-down faucets. I spent hours researching adapters, comparing thread sizes, and trying to find a workaround. I purchased additional parts, searched multiple hardware stores, and still could not get the dishwasher connected to my kitchen sink. I even contacted Whirlpool for assistance. Even my basement utility sink required special adapters because the included connection only fits certain faucet threads. After all of that, I still cannot use this dishwasher where it belongs—in my kitchen. Instead, I now have to carry dirty dishes down to my basement every time I want to run it. That completely defeats the purpose of buying a portable dishwasher. The dishwasher itself may clean dishes well, but Whirlpool's outdated faucet connection design makes it incompatible with many modern homes. If you have a pull-down, pull-out, or other nonstandard faucet, assume this dishwasher will not work without a frustrating amount of trial and error. I would not have purchased this model had I known how difficult it would be to connect.

Sentence (English): While redecorating my home, I also purchased a new dishwasher.
Comments (English): While redecorating my home, I also purchased a new dishwasher. Initially, I considered many other products equipped with AI features, but after comparing various options, I ultimately chose the LG dishwasher, which appealed to me the most. I have always been highly satisfied with LG appliances, so I bought it with confidence, and after using it, I feel it was a choice I truly have no regrets about. Above all, it matches the interior so well that it has made the kitchen atmosphere feel much more luxurious. Thanks to its clean design, it blends naturally with the newly decorated kitchen, and it makes me feel good every time I enter. It feels like the overall completeness of the space has been significantly enhanced just by changing one appliance. In the past, washing dishes several times a day would cause my wrists to ache, and washing dishes after dinner felt like the biggest chore. Since we have children, we have a lot of dishes, and the sink would quickly fill up with everything, even a single water glass, which used to be stressful. However, since using the LG dishwasher, those worries have completely disappeared. It is incredibly convenient; after finishing a meal, I just put the dishes in and press a button, and it cleans them perfectly on its own. My quality of life has definitely improved because I can now use the time I used to spend washing dishes to play with my kids, do housework, or take a short break. I had some reservations at first, but now it has become an indispensable appliance that I use every single day without fail. I highly recommend this product, especially to dual-income families or households with children. It saves time and reduces the stress of washing dishes, making housework much easier. I can confidently say that this is the most satisfying appliance I purchased while renovating my home. I am satisfied with the design, performance, and convenience, and the more I use it, the more I understand why so many people recommend the LG dishwasher. I never thought washing dishes could become enjoyable, but thanks to my "dishwasher lady," every day has become much more comfortable and happy. If you are considering buying one, I confidently recommend it as a choice you won't regret.

Sentence (English): I purchased this as part of our wedding dowry for our new home.
Comments (English): I purchased this as part of our wedding dowry for our new home. At first, since we are a two-person household, I wondered how much dishwashing there could really be, so I considered buying a dishwasher later when our family grew. However, since purchasing all our home appliances at once allowed us to receive a multi-item discount, I decided to get it along with everything else. The conclusion? It would have been a huge mistake not to buy it. As newlyweds, we cook together often, and after we've finished our meal, the sink would quickly fill up with pots, pans, and plates. At first, I thought, "This is quick enough," but doing it every day was actually quite a hassle. Now, all I have to do is put the dishes in and press a button, so dinner time has become much more relaxed. Matching everything with the Objet Collection appliances creates a sense of unity, so I am pleased every time I look at it. Usability. It is easy to load dishes, and it washes them thoroughly and cleanly. It cleans even greasy dishes thoroughly, so the frequency of hand-washing has decreased significantly. Pros: I think it is an essential appliance for newlyweds. It drastically reduces dishwashing time. Since it is built-in, the kitchen looks neat and tidy. It is even better to purchase it together when there is a multi-item discount. After using it, I understood why everyone recommends dishwashers. Overall Review: At first, I thought we didn't need it, but now it is one of the best appliances we bought for our new home. I think satisfaction will be particularly high for couples who cook frequently. If you are wondering, like me, "Is it necessary for a two-person household?", I highly recommend it.

Comments (English): [ Very Quiet & Very Spacious -- 3rd rack is great! ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher from CostCo 7 months ago, and we love the most important aspects of it.1. It has a vast amount of rack space for a standard sized dishwasher; with that third rack being really helpful.2. It is very quiet (itn our real life setting it is quieter than the KDTE304L, which we also have in the same kitchen). Sure, a Bosch might be even quieter. but this KitchenAid 360 Max is so quiet that there is no question in the quietness versus space tradeoff; I'll take this KitchenAid 360 Max 7 days a week (my father has a Bosch, and its amount of rack space seems very small compared to this KitchenAid).3. It gets the dishes very clean. As a matter of fact, the reason I am writing this review is that my sister was just house sitting for us and she was amazed at how clean all of the dishes came out, esp. since we do NOT pre-rinse our dishes (we simply scrape off the excess food and throw them in the dishwasher where there dishes sit for an average of 3 days before we run the dishwasher).If I had any nits about this dishwasher it would be:- The "delay" button is for a fixed 4 hours (no way to subtract or add hours to that).- This model vents the steam at the end of the drying period by automatically popping the door open; I prefer the venting system in KitchenAid's KDTE304L in which at the end of the drying period the dishwasher would vent the steam/moisture to the floor ( we have two dishwashers in our kitchen, and the "hidden" KDTE304L is our other one). The KDTE304L I think does a better job of getting the dishes dryer because of that venting system, but the 360 Max Jets still does a good enough job of drying the dishes that it isn't a deal breaker.Side note:I ended up hiring a private plumber to install the dishwasher because the contract company that CostCo uses refused to install the dishwasher with an air gap, per code. I get them having to do stuff to code since they are a large contracting company, but we didn't want an air gap (we wanted a high-loop just like our previous LG dishwasher had) --- so we ended up hiring a private plumber to install ours.

Comments (English): [ Rack layout odd, silverware cleaning good, cheap feeling door, terrible install from HD ] || ---------------- || It is adequate, but not amazing for the price. Here is why:. (1) some functions require you to use an app. I don't want an app to use my dishwasher. For example the cleaning mode, and notification that rinse aid is running low. (2) the door feels really cheap and extremely light weight and not durable, though I have had no trouble with it. (3) the sales people told me hard wiring was required by this vendor, which is irritation. I later found out by install crew that was not the case. (4) many dishes don't fit great in the racks. My main issues are dinner plates do not easily and nicely fit in the slots. The spacing is just odd. Fry pans and trays are difficult to stand on side, so you have to generally lay them flat which takes up an enormous amount of room and consequently takes extra loads. I do like the silverware tray at the top, that works excellent. (5) HD install was beyond terrible. The biggest problem was they left with a water leak which I found about two hours later when water was seeping out under my cabinets. Their response? We'll send someone back in two days! I had to call a plumber on an urgent basis which was about 4x the install cost! They left with the machine running which makes sense, but they left paperwork, signs, samples, etc. inside the running dishwasher! They left the clear plastic protective film on dishwasher which was very difficult to remove after install because of the way the door was set inside the cabinet - should have been removed before pushing in. Charged me for adding an electrical box which I was told was required, then when the install guy came, they said it was not and it would be refunded automatically due to feedback from install team - but no - I had to call. An absolute terrible install experience that couldn't have gotten much worse. (6) Rinse aid drawer odd - first it is easy to pour rinse aid into the air hole which is way to close. There doesn't seem to be way to monitor your rinse aid status, even on the app (it does tell you when it is out on the app). I don't know why they don't have a visual way to see that like every other washer I have used. It does clean well. though nothing better than the 10 year old one I am replacing (other than silverware which this one definitely cleans better using the upper silverware tray).

Comments (English): [ Flimsy Door Joint ] || ---------------- || The door joint seems to be too flimsy to handle a loaded lower rack of dishes. Our new house builder installed the Whirlpool dishwasher WDT730HAMZ1, and it was first used in September 2024. It worked fine for about 9 months, although we didn't use it often. Then the door slipped slightly downward (instead of being level) when the lower rack of dishes sat on it. The dishwasher was still useable until Thanksgiving 2025 when a full load of dishes rested on the open door and it then slipped even further downward. While washing that load of dishes in the dishwasher, we ended up with a big pool of water on the kitchen floor. Some foam hung out from bottom of the open door, and that could be why the door's seal was no longer sufficient to keep the water inside the tub. Since it was then past the 1-year warranty period, Whirlpool said they wouldn't cover the repair. We're now stuck with an unusable dishwasher.

I already called the repair man out because the top rack appears to be stuck and doesn't seem to want to slide out as far as it will go. Not a huge deal but definitely shouldn't have ANY issues at all right out of the box basically. Had I done more research on different brands or options, I probably would have went with another dishwasher.

I am highly satisfied with the price, and I think it is a great product for households that use a dishwasher frequently to use consistently. I plan to repurchase it next time.
