Comments (English): [ I've been using it for over a month and it's convenient and great. ] || ---------------- || Product Summary. I ordered the LG Electronics DIOS Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher (14-place setting). I often felt that the time spent doing dishes was a waste, and since it puts a strain on my wrists, I deliberated on buying a dishwasher for a long time. After comparing various products, I chose the LG Electronics DIOS Objet Collection 14-place setting, and after using it, I understood why dishwashers are said to be appliances that improve quality of life. Reason for Order. Before purchasing a dishwasher, I spent quite a long time comparing various models from multiple brands, not just LG Electronics. I meticulously examined everything from cleaning power, drying performance, internal configuration, convenience features, and price, and each product had its pros and cons. Among them, I determined that this model offered the most satisfactory price-to-feature ratio, so I made my final choice. Being a 14-place setting, I can wash a large amount of dishes at once, and I also liked the clean design characteristic of the Objet Collection. I also appreciated that it blends naturally with the kitchen since it is a built-in model, and the trust I had in LG Electronics' after-sales service and durability was a major factor in my decision. Review. The Rocket Installation technician was professional, kind, and meticulous with the installation! After finishing the installation, he even stuffed tissues into potential leak spots and asked me to contact him if the tissues got wet, ensuring perfect after-care before leaving. He also spent quite a long time putting great effort into the installation. There was an additional cost of a few tens of thousands of won because the size didn't fit, so he had to cut it with a saw and add a grater. The most satisfying aspect after installation was that dishwashing time was significantly reduced. Since I just have to put the dishes in and press the button after a meal, I can do other housework or rest in the meantime, making my life much more convenient. As it is a 14-place setting, I was able to fit more dishes than I expected at once. Once I got used to arranging the dishes, I could wash pots and pans along with the dishes, so I rarely had to run the cycle multiple times. The cleaning power was also satisfactory. Even greasy plates and dishes with rice stuck to them were cleaned thoroughly, and most items could be taken out and put away immediately after drying. The operating noise was also quieter than expected. It wasn't bothersome even when using it in the evening, and I was satisfied that it was quiet enough not to be noticeable even when standing a short distance away from the kitchen. True to the Objet Collection, the design is clean and didn't detract from the kitchen's atmosphere. Being built-in, it made the kitchen look more organized overall, and it was an appliance that I became more satisfied with the more I used it. The dish arrangement felt a bit unfamiliar at first, but I got used to it quickly after using it a few times. Now, I rarely wash dishes by hand, and having extra time after meals has definitely improved my quality of life. Pros and Cons. Pros: - Excellent value for money compared to other brands in terms of features. - As it is a 14-place setting, you can wash a large number of dishes at once. - Satisfactory cleaning and drying performance. - Relatively quiet operation. - Built-in design makes the kitchen look neat and luxurious. - Easy to use, allowing for quick adaptation. - As an LG Electronics product, I have confidence in its after-sales service and durability. Cons: - You need to check the installation space in advance. - The dish arrangement might feel a bit unfamiliar at first. - Maintenance costs tend to be slightly higher as you must use dedicated detergent and rinse aid. Overall Review: Before purchasing this dishwasher, I compared many brands and models. Considering various features and price comprehensively, this was the most satisfying choice. After actually using it, I found that dishwashing time was significantly reduced, easing the burden of housework. Both the cleaning power and convenience exceeded my expectations. I would recommend this product to anyone who finds dishwashing a hassle or is looking for an appliance that improves their quality of life. In particular, if you live with your family, the generous 14-place setting capacity will likely be even more satisfying. After comparing various products, I chose the LG Electronics DIOS Objet Collection 14-place setting, and after using it, I understood why dishwashers are said to be appliances that improve quality of life. Reason for Order. Before purchasing a dishwasher, I spent quite a long time comparing various models from multiple brands, not just LG Electronics. Being a 14-place setting, I can wash a large amount of dishes at once, and I also liked the clean design characteristic of the Objet Collection. I also appreciated that it blends naturally with the kitchen since it is a built-in model, and the trust I had in LG Electronics' after-sales service and durability was a major factor in my decision. Review. The Rocket Installation technician was professional, kind, and meticulous with the installation! After finishing the installation, he even stuffed tissues into potential leak spots and asked me to contact him if the tissues got wet, ensuring perfect after-care before leaving. He also spent quite a long time putting great effort into the installation. There was an additional cost of a few tens of thousands of won because the size didn't fit, so he had to cut it with a saw and add a grater. The most satisfying aspect after installation was that dishwashing time was significantly reduced. Since I just have to put the dishes in and press the button after a meal, I can do other housework or rest in the meantime, making my life much more convenient. As it is a 14-place setting, I was able to fit more dishes than I expected at once. Once I got used to arranging the dishes, I could wash pots and pans along with the dishes, so I rarely had to run the cycle multiple times. The cleaning power was also satisfactory. Even greasy plates and dishes with rice stuck to them were cleaned thoroughly, and most items could be taken out and put away immediately after drying. The operating noise was also quieter than expected. It wasn't bothersome even when using it in the evening, and I was satisfied that it was quiet enough not to be noticeable even when standing a short distance away from the kitchen. True to the Objet Collection, the design is clean and didn't detract from the kitchen's atmosphere. Being built-in, it made the kitchen look more organized overall, and it was an appliance that I became more satisfied with the more I used it. The dish arrangement felt a bit unfamiliar at first, but I got used to it quickly after using it a few times. Now, I rarely wash dishes by hand, and having extra time after meals has definitely improved my quality of life. Pros and Cons. Cons: - You need to check the installation space in advance. - The dish arrangement might feel a bit unfamiliar at first. - Maintenance costs tend to be slightly higher as you must use dedicated detergent and rinse aid. Overall Review: Before purchasing this dishwasher, I compared many brands and models. Considering various features and price comprehensively, this was the most satisfying choice. I would recommend this product to anyone who finds dishwashing a hassle or is looking for an appliance that improves their quality of life. In particular, if you live with your family, the generous 14-place setting capacity will likely be even more satisfying. After finishing the installation, he even stuffed tissues into potential leak spots and asked me to contact him if the tissues got wet, ensuring perfect after-care before leaving. He also spent quite a long time putting great effort into the installation. There was an additional cost of a few tens of thousands of won because the size didn't fit, so he had to cut it with a saw and add a grater. The most satisfying aspect after installation was that dishwashing time was significantly reduced. Since I just have to put the dishes in and press the button after a meal, I can do other housework or rest in the meantime, making my life much more convenient. As it is a 14-place setting, I was able to fit more dishes than I expected at once. Cons: - You need to check the installation space in advance. - The dish arrangement might feel a bit unfamiliar at first. - Maintenance costs tend to be slightly higher as you must use dedicated detergent and rinse aid. In particular, if you live with your family, the generous 14-place setting capacity will likely be even more satisfying. I was satisfied with the professional installation process. First, I received calls from two technicians: a renovation technician and a product installation technician. He then removed the cabinet at the installation location, went out, renovated a minimalist cabinet, and brought it back. He told me to store dishwasher detergent and rinse aid there if I planned to use them, and even showed me storage containers, saying they sell everything at Daiso. Amazing. Thank you. I tried the product right away; I intentionally put in silicone cooking utensils that were heavily greased and ran the cycle, and they came out squeaky clean. With silicone brushes, no matter how much I soaked and washed them, nothing worked, but this is no joke. The smell is gone too. I wrote this review a bit rambling, but it is just an absolute game changer.
